description: This PHP class 'PimReport' is part of a human resources management system (OrangeHRM). It implements end-point report functionalities including handling report data generation, filter definitions, validation, and access control related to Personnel Information Management (PIM) reports.

classes.name: PimReport
classes.description: Represents a report for Personnel Information Management (PIM), providing functionalities for report generation, filtering, validation, and access control within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService used for generating reports.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header configuration for the report based on report ID.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides a new Filter object defining the report's filtering capabilities.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data for the report based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates the filter parameters based on request parameters and report ID.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for incoming request parameters related to report generation.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the report can be accessed, throwing an exception if not permitted.
